name: hcportal_addEditEvent
description: Creates a new run/event or updates an existing one for a kennel from the Flutter portal run editor. @publicEventId NULL = insert, non-NULL = update (the event must belong to @publicKennelId). Handles name, description, location, structured CountryId/RegionId/CityId, manual TimezoneId, pricing, tags, dissemination settings; optionally saves the tags as the kennel's defaults; then renumbers runs (HC6.nonApi_updateRunNumbers) and refreshes attendees' run counts (HC6.nonApi_updateRunCountsForEventUsers) inside the same transaction. On update, a run imported by the AI runs-page import is 'adopted' (HC6.nonApi_adoptImportedRun) and its UseFb* mirror flags are forced to 0 so the import stops overwriting it. Auth: HC6.ValidatePortalAuth with @publicKennelId as callerParamString (token = UPPER(deviceSecret):UPPER(publicKennelId)). There is NO kennel permission gate — any authenticated portal device can write events for any kennel (see codeSmells). Renamed from HC5 hcportal_addEditEvent2; @deleted removed — deletion is exclusively via hcportal_deleteEvent. Permission (2026-10-13): HC6.nonApi_portalKennelAccess — AppAccessFlags 0x40000085 (SuperAdmin, Admin, public-web 0x80, Manage runs 0x4), createEditRuns, or platform CanEditKennel; otherwise {Success 0, ErrorMessage 'Not authorised to edit runs for this kennel'} after rollback.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Auth: device ID used to look up the authenticated user and device secret. Validated via HC6.ValidatePortalAuth.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Auth: short-lived cryptographic token, validated via HC6.ValidatePortalAuth.

parameters.name: publicKennelId
parameters.description: Required: the kennel the event belongs to. Also the callerParamString baked into the access token. Defaults to NULL so the SP can return 'publicKennelId is required' (checked AFTER auth, so a NULL value in practice fails auth first).

parameters.name: absoluteEventNumber
parameters.description: Optional absolute event number. -1 is normalised to NULL (no change). Insert: -2 → NULL, otherwise stored as given. Update: any value <= 0 clears the column; NULL keeps it.

parameters.name: eventImage
parameters.description: URL for the event image. Sentinel: '<null>' sets the column to NULL. Strings shorter than 3 chars (LEN) normalised to NULL.

parameters.name: eventEndDatetime
parameters.description: Event end date/time. Values <= 1/1/2000 normalised to NULL.

parameters.name: eventDescription
parameters.description: Free-text event description. Strings shorter than 1 char (LEN) normalised to NULL. Unicode paragraph separators (U+2028, U+2029) stripped.

parameters.name: eventGeographicScope
parameters.description: Geographic scope (1=Normal, 2=Local special, 3=Regional, 4=National, 5=Continental, 6=Global, 7=Other). Sentinel: -1 normalised to NULL. Defaults to 1 on insert.

parameters.name: eventName
parameters.description: Event display name. Widened from NVARCHAR(120) in HC5 to match table column. Strings shorter than 1 char (LEN) normalised to NULL. Auto-generated placeholder if blank on insert.

parameters.name: eventPriceForExtras
parameters.description: Price for extras/add-ons. Changed from FLOAT (HC5) to DECIMAL(10,4) to match table column. Sentinels: -1 normalised to NULL (no change), -2 sets the column to NULL.

parameters.name: eventPriceForMembers
parameters.description: Event price for members. Changed from FLOAT (HC5) to DECIMAL(10,4) to match table column. Sentinels: -1 normalised to NULL (no change), -2 sets the column to NULL.

parameters.name: eventPriceForNonMembers
parameters.description: Event price for non-members. Changed from FLOAT (HC5) to DECIMAL(10,4) to match table column. Sentinels: -1 normalised to NULL (no change), -2 sets the column to NULL.

parameters.name: extrasDescription
parameters.description: Description of extras. Sentinel: '<null>' sets column to NULL. Strings shorter than 1 char (LEN) normalised to NULL.

parameters.name: extrasRsvpRequired
parameters.description: Whether RSVP is required for extras. Defaults to 0 on insert.

parameters.name: hares
parameters.description: Hare names. Sentinel: '<null>' sets column to NULL. Strings shorter than 2 chars (LEN) normalised to NULL.

parameters.name: integrationEnabled
parameters.description: Event.IntegrationEnabled. NULL keeps existing on update (falls back to 1 if the column were NULL); on insert defaults to 0. Note the different fallbacks (insert 0, update 1).

parameters.name: isCountedRun
parameters.description: -1 normalised to NULL. Insert: defaults to 1. Update: NULL keeps existing (fallback 0).

parameters.name: isPromotedEvent
parameters.description: Whether this is a promoted/featured event. Sentinel: -1 normalised to NULL. Defaults to 0.

parameters.name: isVisible
parameters.description: Whether this event is visible to users. Sentinel: -1 normalised to NULL. Defaults to 1.

parameters.name: hcLatitude
parameters.description: Event latitude. Sentinels: -1 normalised to NULL (no change), -999.0 sets the column to NULL (sentinel changed from -99.0 in HC5). Also updates Event.EventGeolocation (geography::Point).

parameters.name: locationCity
parameters.description: City name. Sentinel: '<null>' sets column to NULL. Strings shorter than 1 char (LEN) normalised to NULL.

parameters.name: locationCountry
parameters.description: Country name. Sentinel: '<null>' sets column to NULL. Strings shorter than 1 char (LEN) normalised to NULL.

parameters.name: locationOneLineDesc
parameters.description: One-line location description. Sentinel: '<null>' sets column to NULL. Strings shorter than 1 char (LEN) normalised to NULL. Unicode paragraph separators stripped.

parameters.name: locationPostCode
parameters.description: Postal/zip code. Widened from NVARCHAR(50) in HC5 to match table column. Sentinel: '<null>' sets column to NULL. Strings shorter than 1 char (LEN) normalised to NULL.

parameters.name: locationRegion
parameters.description: Region/state. Sentinel: '<null>' sets column to NULL. Strings shorter than 1 char (LEN) normalised to NULL.

parameters.name: locationStreet
parameters.description: Street address. Sentinel: '<null>' sets column to NULL. Strings shorter than 1 char (LEN) normalised to NULL.

parameters.name: locationSubRegion
parameters.description: Sub-region/district. Sentinel: '<null>' sets column to NULL. Strings shorter than 1 char (LEN) normalised to NULL.

parameters.name: hcLongitude
parameters.description: Event longitude. Sentinels: -1 normalised to NULL (no change), -999.0 sets the column to NULL. Also updates Event.EventGeolocation.

parameters.name: maximumParticipantsAllowed
parameters.description: Maximum participants cap. Sentinel: -2 sets column to NULL.

parameters.name: minimumParticipantsRequired
parameters.description: Minimum participants required. Sentinel: -2 sets column to NULL.

parameters.name: publicEventId
parameters.description: If provided, identifies an existing event to update (UPDATE path). If NULL, a new event is inserted (INSERT path). Generated internally on insert and returned in the success rowset.

parameters.name: newPublicEventId
parameters.description: Public id the portal minted for a NEW run (E3.F1.S7, 2026-10-14), sent on every save of it. A run in this kennel with that public id is a repeated save and is edited; otherwise the run is inserted with it. NULL = the SP mints both ids (the old behaviour). Ignored when @publicEventId is given.

parameters.name: saveTagsAsKennelDefault
parameters.description: If 1, saves the provided tags1/tags2/tags3 values as the kennel's DefaultRunTags1/2/3. Only updates if tags differ from current kennel defaults.

parameters.name: eventStartDatetime
parameters.description: Run start. Values <= 2000-01-01 are treated as NULL. Insert: NULL → now + 3 days; if the time part is midnight (or NULL), the kennel's DefaultRunStartTime is added. Update: NULL keeps existing.

parameters.name: tags1
parameters.description: Primary event tag bitfield. Defaults to 0 on insert.

parameters.name: tags2
parameters.description: Secondary event tag bitfield. Defaults to 0 on insert.

parameters.name: tags3
parameters.description: Tertiary event tag bitfield. Defaults to 0 on insert.

parameters.name: useFbImage
parameters.description: Update only: -1 → NULL (no change), otherwise written to Event.UseFbImage. Ignored on insert (always 0). Forced to 0 after the update when the run was an adopted AI import.

parameters.name: useFbLatLon
parameters.description: Update only: -1 → NULL (no change), otherwise written to Event.UseFbLatLon. Ignored on insert (always 0). Forced to 0 after the update when the run was an adopted AI import.

parameters.name: useFbLocation
parameters.description: Update only: -1 → NULL (no change), otherwise written to Event.UseFbLocation. Ignored on insert (always 0). Forced to 0 after the update when the run was an adopted AI import.

parameters.name: useFbRunDetails
parameters.description: Update only: -1 → NULL (no change), otherwise written to Event.UseFbRunDetails. Ignored on insert (always 0). Forced to 0 after the update when the run was an adopted AI import.

parameters.name: canEditRunAttendence
parameters.description: Whether users can edit their own attendance. Sentinel: -1 normalised to NULL (no change), -2 sets column to NULL.

parameters.name: evtDisseminationAudience
parameters.description: Event-level dissemination audience override. Sentinel: -1 normalised to NULL (no change), -2 sets column to NULL.

parameters.name: evtDisseminateAllowWebLinks
parameters.description: Whether dissemination allows web links. Sentinel: -1 normalised to NULL (no change), -2 sets column to NULL. Sentinel fixed from HC5 (was '2' in HC5, now correctly '-2').

parameters.name: evtDisseminateHashRunsDotOrg
parameters.description: Whether to disseminate to HashRuns.org. Sentinel: -1 normalised to NULL (no change), -2 sets column to NULL.

parameters.name: evtDisseminateOnGlobalGoogleCalendar
parameters.description: Whether to publish to the global Google Calendar. Sentinel: -1 normalised to NULL (no change), -2 sets column to NULL.

parameters.name: countryId
parameters.description: Event.CountryId. Update: NULL keeps existing; a non-NULL value also touches updatedAt on every HasherEventMap row for the event. Insert: NULL falls back to the kennel's CountryId.

parameters.name: regionId
parameters.description: Event.RegionId (column added by db/hc6/portal/archive/HC.Event.AddRegionIdCityId_20260628.sql; missing from db/schema/tables/HC.Event.Table.sql). NULL = no change; empty GUID 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000 = clear.

parameters.name: cityId
parameters.description: Event.CityId (column added by db/hc6/portal/archive/HC.Event.AddRegionIdCityId_20260628.sql; missing from the schema file). NULL = no change; empty GUID = clear.

parameters.name: timezoneId
parameters.description: Event.TimezoneId manual timezone override, references DomainValues.Timezone.id (column added by db/hc6/portal/archive/HC.Event.AddTimezoneId_20260628.sql; missing from the schema file). NULL = no change; 0 = clear.

parameters.name: packOffMinutes
parameters.description: Pack-off (E3.F1.S6): minutes after the gather (the start time) that the pack leaves. NULL / -1 = keep, -2 = clear (the run then uses the kennel's default), 0..600 = this run's own. Outside 0..600 is refused. Refusal: Success 0.

rowsets.name: ErrorEnvelope
rowsets.description: Returned on any auth, validation, not-found, concurrent-modification or runtime (CATCH) error. Short-circuits; nothing else is returned.

columns.name: ErrorMessage
columns.description: 'Authentication failed', 'deviceId is required', 'publicKennelId is required', 'Invalid publicEventId format', 'Kennel not found', 'Event not found', 'Concurrent modification detected - please refresh and try again', or ERROR_MESSAGE() from the CATCH block

rowsets.name: SuccessResult
rowsets.description: Returned after COMMIT on a successful insert or update. Single row. Note: business data in rowset 0 with no Success column.

columns.name: result
columns.description: 'Successfully updated <KennelShortName> run/event #<EventNumber>' (or without the number) on update; 'Run added to Harrier Central' on insert

columns.name: publicEventId
columns.description: Existing PublicEventId on update, newly generated one on insert

sideEffects: Update path: EXEC HC6.nonApi_adoptImportedRun (marks an AI runs-page import as adopted); UPDATE HC.Event (COALESCE no-change semantics, EventLastUpdatedSource='HC Portal', EventLastUpdatedBy=@hasherId, updatedAt=GETDATE()); if adopted, a second UPDATE forces UseFbRunDetails/UseFbLocation/UseFbLatLon/UseFbImage = 0
Update path with @countryId non-NULL: UPDATE HC.HasherEventMap.updatedAt for every row of the event (forces re-sync to phones)
Insert path: INSERT HC.Event with new id and PublicEventId, EventSource='HC Portal', InboundIntegrationId=0, UseFb* = 0
UPDATE HC.Kennel DefaultRunTags1/2/3 when @saveTagsAsKennelDefault = 1 and a value differs
EXEC HC6.nonApi_updateRunNumbers @eventId and EXEC HC6.nonApi_updateRunCountsForEventUsers @eventId, inside the transaction
HC.Event triggers (updatedAt / sync) fire on the INSERT/UPDATE
Calls HC6.nonApi_portalKennelAccess (read-only) for its permission check.

codeSmells.issue: CATCH does not log to HC.ErrorLog
codeSmells.detail: Lines 490-493 roll back and return the error envelope but insert nothing into HC.ErrorLog, so runtime failures (renumber, run-count refresh, geography::Point) leave no server-side record.

codeSmells.issue: Business data in rowset 0 without success envelope
codeSmells.detail: Line 487 returns result/resultCode/publicEventId as rowset 0 with no Success column; the error path returns Success/ErrorMessage in the same position. Callers must distinguish by column name.

codeSmells.issue: Inconsistent defaults between insert and update
codeSmells.detail: IntegrationEnabled falls back to 1 on update (line 237) but 0 on insert (line 431); IsCountedRun falls back to 0 on update (line 233) but 1 on insert (line 399).

codeSmells.issue: Sentinel magic values, inconsistent across parameters
codeSmells.detail: -1 = no change (lines 143-173), -2 = clear for numerics, -999.0 = clear lat/lon, '<null>' = clear strings, empty GUID = clear region/city (lines 287-288), 0 = clear timezone (line 292), and AbsoluteEventNumber is cleared by any value <= 0 on update (line 265) but only by -2 on insert (line 432).

TRY_CAST(@publicEventId AS uniqueidentifier) (line 119) can never fail — the parameter is already UNIQUEIDENTIFIER. The publicKennelId NULL check (line 112) runs after auth, which already used it as the token context.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning (e.g. -999.0 for geo null, -2 for numeric null, '<null>' for string null, -1 for no-change)
Never re-add @deleted parameter — deletion is exclusively via hcportal_deleteEvent
